newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 14.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Monday's Daily Variety:

NEW YORK - Following the Time Warner Inc - Turner Broadcasting System Inc merger, New Line Cinema is slated to get a $100 million increase in its production budget for the coming year to $450 million.

HOLLYWOOD - Eastman Kodak Co has launched Entertainment Imaging, a division geared toward exploiting opportunities for new business development in various show business categories like theme parks, including possible joint content deals with Hollywood production companies.
